key_note: Rocky now launches safely even when a laptop has microphone or speaker issues, and adds richer Control Center settings plus more natural curious wandering.
whats_new: Fixed startup crashes caused by PyAudio host errors on laptops with unavailable or misconfigured audio devices
Rocky now opens microphone and speaker devices lazily instead of during app startup
Added audio status and Retry Audio Devices inside Control Center
Added Control Center toggles for speech bubbles, voice output, screen sharing, proactive nudges, weather/news nudges, support nudges, cursor curiosity, and wandering
Added cursor curiosity controls for follow chance and side distance
Rocky now follows the cursor from the side instead of sitting directly under it
Rocky now wanders around more naturally with small curious movements
Simplified the pet right-click menu to reduce duplicate settings and keep preferences inside Control Center
Kept the app version at v1.4 for this stability update
